sources.access_scope: Version of Record; CC BY 4.0; publisher Results/Discussion/Methods inspected; supplements not inspected; raw matrices on request.

sources.unresolved_evidence: Correlated extreme-eigenvalue prediction, detector-specific mapping and raw-data reproduction remain open.

sources.access_scope: Published article; CC BY 4.0; seven-page publisher PDF inspected; supplement not inspected.
sources.bounded_support: Singular funnels can change full-system basin geometry relative to a reduced model. This challenges a basin-preservation assumption; it does not show that ASTRA has or avoids such funnels.
sources.unresolved_evidence: Specify target equations, small parameter, perturbations and time horizon. Asymptotic basins are not finite observation-time guarantees.
